description: One complete electric power installation: 800 rpm/V outrunner, ideal ESC, 4S 3.2 Ah battery (open-circuit voltage and resistance law) and a 12x6 propeller. Electrical data and propeller tables are taken from the donor record, a synthetic estimated fixture; hardware masses and sizes are catalogue-range estimates, not a specific product. Derivation: docs/research/aircraft-creator/estimated-trainer-package.md.

kv_rpm_per_volt.source: Donor propulsion.motor.kv_rpm_per_volt (synthetic EL1b demo value, no measured motor)

resistance_ohm.source: Donor propulsion.motor.resistance_ohm (synthetic EL1b equivalent winding resistance, no measured motor)

no_load_current_a.source: Donor propulsion.motor.no_load_current_a (synthetic EL1b demo value, no measured motor)

capacity_ah.source: Donor propulsion.battery.capacity_ah (EL2a synthetic authored fixture, not a measured LiPo)

resistance_ohm.source: Donor propulsion.battery.resistance_ohm (EL2a synthetic authored fixture, not a measured LiPo)

ocv_points.source: Donor propulsion.battery.ocv_points: linear 3.0 to 4.2 V per cell over state of charge (EL2a synthetic authored fixture, not a measured LiPo fit)

rotating_inertia.source: Donor propulsion.propeller.rotating_inertia (synthetic EL1b rotor inertia: propeller plus motor bell)

ct_table.source: Donor propulsion.propeller.ct_table: UIUC propeller database vol. 1, measured APC Sport 11x6 (apcsp_11x6_static_rd0488.txt, apcsp_11x6_rd0495_6000.txt), applied to the 12x6 by T = Ct·ρ·n²·D⁴; linear between J = 0 and 0.373

cp_table.source: Donor propulsion.propeller.cp_table: UIUC propeller database vol. 1, measured APC Sport 11x6 (apcsp_11x6_static_rd0488.txt, apcsp_11x6_rd0495_6000.txt), applied to the 12x6

motor_behind_hub.source: Motor centre behind the propeller hub: 0.015 m adapter plus half of a 0.05 m outrunner

firewall_behind_hub.source: Motor rear face behind the propeller hub: 0.015 m adapter plus a 0.05 m outrunner

spinner_length.source: Small spinner or prop nut ahead of the hub, for the crash-hull nose point

mass.source: Typical 42 mm class 800 rpm/V outrunner for a 12x6 propeller on 4S (catalogue range 0.16-0.21 kg); not a specific product
APC 12x6 1.62 oz (0.046 kg, donor inventory) plus collet adapter and small spinner 0.02 kg

size.source: Donor propeller envelope for intrinsic inertia

mass.source: Typical 60 A brushless speed controller with leads (catalogue range 0.05-0.08 kg)
Typical 4S 3200 mAh 30C LiPo pack (catalogue range 0.32-0.38 kg)

size.source: Typical 4S 3200 mAh pack envelope, long axis fore-aft
